summary: Adds a narrow checkpoint resume executor for the MaterializeStagedFile action. The executor consumes the rev0682 action plan, revalidates staged bytes and receipt sidecars, materializes complete staged files, and updates SQLite materialization evidence while leaving cleanup as an explicit next action.
audit_findings: Rev0682 correctly classified complete staged evidence as MaterializeStagedFile, but mutation was still left to future callers.

The hardest part of this branch is not the rename; it is tying the rename to the same durable checkpoint, source filesystem, staged-file, receipt, and target preflight evidence used by the action router.

Checkpoint apply intents do not yet persist enough local target preflight evidence to safely replay overwrites, so the new executor must fail-close on overwrite replay rather than infer missing local size/hash/kind fields.
materialize_resume_checks: execute_sync_session_checkpoint_resume_materializations loads plan_sync_session_checkpoint_resume_actions and mutates only files classified as MaterializeStagedFile.
The executor refuses QuarantineStaging and RejectDrift plans by default.
The checkpoint database is opened read/write only after root, identity, and sqlite path safety checks are repeated.
Staged files are rehashed immediately before materialization against checkpointed size/content hash evidence.
Every receipt sidecar is rehashed back to the persisted sync-chunk-receipt:v1 idempotency key before filesystem mutation.
Absent destination targets are materialized with an atomic rename from staging into the destination tree.
Already-present destination targets must be regular files with expected content before the executor may finalize SQLite materialization evidence idempotently.
The executor writes or refreshes sync_session_materialization_checkpoints with a sync-materialize:v1 idempotency key and updates sync_session_file_results materialized state.
Post-action verification expects the materialized path to become CleanupCommittedStaging, leaving receipt cleanup explicit.
